slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that give you a
fearless kind of confidence

the honest compliment

give one sincere, specific compliment a day, out loud and face to face. people who see the good in others are the ones everyone quietly wants to be around.

finishing your sentences

for a week, don't let anyone finish your sentences for you. keep talking calmly to the end, and notice how quickly your voice starts to sound sure of itself.

having things to talk about

spend 5 minutes a day learning something new instead of scrolling, and you'll never run out of things to say. confident people almost always have one interesting story ready.
slides.texte_sophia:
having things to talk about

i spend 5 minutes a day learning something new instead of scrolling. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and i never run out of interesting things to say.

slides.texte_overlay:
recording yourself

record yourself telling a short story once a week and listen back. you'll see what to improve, and you'll realise you sound far better than you think.

one brave call a day

make one phone call a day that you'd normally avoid: a booking, a question, a friend. the nerves before are always so much worse than the call itself.
